scope: P30S Qwen3.5: 30 tasks x 3 repetitions x 4 conditions; includes 60 previously completed FC/TR run_1 results.

findings.trigger: Agent-generated script mutates the same list being iterated, repeatedly printing Fixed line; 8 multi-gigabyte timeout outputs at steps 88,96,101,105,110,113,118,125.
findings.code_mechanism: Docker execute buffers stdout in memory; observation rendering limits visible text but retains full extra.raw_output; trajectory is fully serialized and overwritten non-atomically every step. Compression changes visible content without bounding raw metadata.
findings.interpretation: Cannot treat this run as solely a model/compression failure. Exact contribution of I/O to elapsed time has not been isolated.
findings.recommended_fix: Bound subprocess output collection; separate raw artifacts from hot trajectory metadata; atomically replace trajectory; recover completed call count from token_log on parse failure.

findings.mechanism: Completion marker plus successful command exit accepts source excerpts or selected added lines as final submissions. Nonempty text sets patch_generated. These 6 fail patch application.
findings.offline_reproduction: Plain text after completion marker raises Submitted.
findings.interpretation: Evaluation failures are correct for the submitted artifacts; successful repair after a validation fix is not established. Do not reject valid unified diffs merely for lacking diff --git.
findings.recommended_fix: Validate the benchmark submission format and return actionable feedback before terminating.

findings.interpretation: SU-free contains complete-turn truncation in 25.3% of its compression events. Same prompt retried up to five times; intended fallback, not wrong primitive dispatch.

32K generations ending without usable actions consume time. These logs establish wasted time, not that an implementation defect caused the model output. The giant-file run has zero such length errors.

limits: Full factual correctness of each summary has not been assessed.
Excluded giant trajectory cannot be fully replayed; giant JSONL records scanned in bounded chunks.
Per-run metrics of retained FC/TR run_1 predate newer bookkeeping fields.
A fix would not guarantee any additional resolved tasks.
changes: Only new audit artifacts written; experiment code and data unchanged.
